---
name: Cloudflare Workers local dev
description: CF Workers local dev is working; run pnpm dev:cf from root; key shims and patterns established
type: project
---

CF Workers local dev is working as of 2026-04-30 on branch feat/cloudflare-deployment.

**How to run:** `pnpm dev:cf` from root (or `pnpm dev` inside `packages/deploy-cloudflare`). Runs build-worker.mjs then `wrangler dev --no-bundle --local` on port 8787. Use `.dev.vars` with `DEPLOYMENT_MODE=local_trusted` to bypass auth.

**Key architecture decisions:**
- Custom esbuild bundler (build-worker.mjs) pre-bundles worker because wrangler 3 has no alias/external config
- Route handlers close over DB via service instances → DB must be rebuilt per-request (not cached across requests) to avoid CF Workers "Cannot perform I/O on behalf of a different request" error
- Route path regexps ARE cached (compiledPathCache module var) since they're stateless
- 229 routes compiled from Express-style route factories via express-router-bridge

**Shims in packages/deploy-cloudflare/src/shims/:**
- pino, pino-http → pino-shim.ts (console-backed logger)
- express → cf-express-shim.ts (zero-dep Router with param() no-op)
- server/src/middleware/logger.ts → server-logger-shim.ts (esbuild plugin intercept)
- server/src/version.ts → server-version-shim.ts (no createRequire)
- dotenv, multer → no-op shims (not needed in CF)
- node:http/https/net/tls/fs/etc. → stubs
- Banner polyfills: process.hrtime, process.cwd, process.chdir, process.exit

**Why:** Getting Node.js server codebase (Express, pino, multer, AWS SDK, postgres) to run in CF Workers which provides only a subset of Node.js APIs via nodejs_compat flag.
